recognize_zh: 這是同一中期分裂相的反轉 DAPI 影像（染色體呈灰黑色類似 G 帶，方便辨認染色體）：der(9) 與 Ph 各有一個融合訊號，正常 9 號為紅、22 號為綠（2F1R1G），7 號與 dic(7;12) 皆有完整的 7q 探針訊號，12 號與 dic(7;12) 各有一個 CEP12 紅訊號。
features: Reverse (inverted) DAPI metaphase image rendering chromosomes grey-black with G-like banding for chromosome identification
BCR/ABL1 dual-fusion probe: red ABL1 signal on normal chromosome 9, green BCR signal on normal chromosome 22
Red-green fusion signals on der(9) and the Philadelphia chromosome (2F1R1G pattern)
CEP12 red signals on normal chromosome 12 and the dic(7;12)
Aqua, red and green del(7q) probe signals present on both normal chromosome 7 and dic(7;12), indicating no 7q deletion
describe_en: Reverse DAPI image of a metaphase hybridized with a BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion probe, a chromosome 12 centromere enumeration probe, and a triple-color 7q deletion probe; inversion of the DAPI counterstain produces G-like banding that allows each signal to be assigned to a specific chromosome. The BCR/ABL1 probe shows a 2F1R1G pattern with fusion signals on der(9) and the Philadelphia chromosome. CEP12 signals localize to the normal chromosome 12 and the dic(7;12), and the 7q probe signal set is present on both the normal chromosome 7 and the dic(7;12). These findings confirm t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with BCR::ABL1 fusion and localize chromosome 7 and 12 material to the dic(7;12) without 7q loss.

ddx.vs: Deletions adjacent to the der(9) breakpoint remove one fusion signal, whereas two fusion signals are present here.
These would show only one set of 7q probe signals, whereas two complete sets are present.
Chance colocalization in interphase can mimic fusion, whereas metaphase localization here assigns the fusion signals to der(9) and Ph.
